title: The memory block of zethus.config.json and amphion.config.json
description: One schema for both kits. Every key is optional and the engine's defaults apply to any that is left out (lessons-capture spec, section 4.7). Q2's exclusions are not keys, by design.

enabled.description: false turns capture off. Default true.

mode.description: shadow records candidates and logs decisions only; active stores and asks. Default shadow.

repo.description: The memory repo, when MNEMOSYNE_REPO is not set.

signals.description: Signal names or ids that may be stored without asking: adr, gate-red-green, explicit-remember.

perSession.description: How many an auto-store may save in one session. Default 5.

signals.description: Signals still in shadow that this project opts into asking.

watch.description: Paths, globs or {path, kind} entries whose writes become candidates. Left out, they come from each kit's own config keys.

offerTier.description: The tier the agent suggests first when it asks to share: shared, or a store in config.stores. Empty suggests none.
